title: Unknown corporate-looking recruiter email with no independently resolved employer domain
description: Recruiter uses a plausible custom corporate domain (apexhorizon-holdings.example), but web search finds no official presence for claimed employer Apex Horizon Tech.
unresolved_facts: No official corporate domain or registration found for Apex Horizon Tech
Domain apexhorizon-holdings.example cannot be verified as authentic employer infrastructure
raw_text:
Greetings from Apex Horizon Tech.
We were impressed with your portfolio and would like to extend an offer for the position of Junior DevOps Engineer.
Salary: INR 5,00,000 CTC.
Please reply to recruiter.v@apexhorizon-holdings.example to confirm your availability for joining on 1st November.

recruiter_assessment.summary: Recruiter domain cannot be verified because employer official domain is unresolved.

rationale: An unknown corporate email domain cannot be certified as genuine without an independently resolved official employer domain. Unresolved identity must result in CANNOT_VERIFY, not VERIFIED.
